```{python}
#| label: fig-fp6-tx-chain
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Simplified transmit path of the Fairphone (Gen. 6) for band 1 or band 3. The supply of the PA comes from an average power tracker; a directional coupler between the antenna switch and the antenna feeds a sample of the TX signal back to the feedback receiver (FBRX) of the RFIC. The I and Q paths of the direct-conversion transmitter are drawn as one."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
import schemdraw.dsp as dsp

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=12, margin=0.5)

    qin = dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit * 0.6)
    elm.Label().at((qin.start[0] - 0.25, qin.start[1])).label('QLink', halign='right', valign='center')
    dsp_ = dsp.Box(w=1.4, h=1).label('DSP')
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    dac = dsp.Dac().label('DAC', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    lpf = dsp.Filter(response='lp').label('LPF', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    mix = dsp.Mixer().anchor('W').label('I/Q', loc='top', ofst=0.1)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3).at(mix.E)
    drv = dsp.Amp().label('driver', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit * 0.8)
    pa = dsp.Amp().label('PA', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 4)
    bsw = dsp.Box(w=1.2, h=1).label('band\nswitch')
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit * 0.6)
    flt = dsp.Filter(response='bp').label('B1/B3\nquadplexer', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    sw = dsp.Box(w=1.6, h=1).label('antenna\nswitch')
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    cpl = dsp.Box(w=1.4, h=1).label('coupler')
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    dpx = dsp.Filter(response='lp').label('diplexer\nLMH | UHB', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    elm.Antenna()

    # LO of the transmitter
    dsp.Arrow().down(d.unit * 0.9).at(mix.S).reverse()
    vco = dsp.OscillatorBox().right().anchor('N').label('LO (PLL)', loc='right', ofst=0.15)

    # supply of the PA from the average power tracker
    pa_top = ((pa.input.x + pa.out.x) / 2, pa.input.y + 0.5)
    dsp.Arrow().up(d.unit * 1.2).at(pa_top).reverse()
    apt = dsp.Box(w=2.4, h=1).anchor('S').label('tracker\n(QET3930)')
    dsp.Arrow().left(d.unit * 0.8).at(apt.W).reverse().label('$V_\\mathrm{BAT}$', loc='top')

    # feedback receiver: coupler -> FBRX switch -> FBRX (mixer, ADC) -> DSP
    fb = dsp.Box(w=2.2, h=1).at(((dsp_.E.x + mix.W.x) / 2, vco.S.y + 0.5)).anchor('center').label('FBRX\nmixer, ADC')
    dsp.Arrow().left().at(vco.W).tox(fb.E)
    y_fb = vco.S.y - 1.8
    dsp.Line().down().at(cpl.S).toy(y_fb)
    dsp.Line().left(d.unit * 2.2)
    fsw = dsp.Box(w=1.6, h=1).label('FBRX\nswitch')
    dsp.Line().left().tox(fb.S.x)
    dsp.Arrow().up().toy(fb.S)
    dsp.Line().left().at(fb.W).tox(dsp_.S.x)
    dsp.Arrow().up().toy(dsp_.S)

    elm.EncircleBox([pa, bsw], padx=0.25, pady=0.9).linestyle('--').label('MMPA module', loc='bottom')
    elm.EncircleBox([dsp_, dac, lpf, mix, drv, vco, fb], padx=0.3, pady=0.8).linestyle('--').label('RFIC (SDR735)', loc='top')
```
